page.overview:
Who is Beejinz?

Beejinz was a male Twi'lek merchant who lived on Tython during the Cold War with the resurgent Sith Empire.

A Twi'lek male, Beejinz was one of many Pilgrims who settled illegally on the planet Tython in the Deep Core. He ran a business in the Jedi Temple.
